task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Take the colorful cartoon mug with one arm, rotate it, and hang it onto the rack with two rods sticking out.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用一只手臂拿起彩色卡通马克杯，旋转它，用伸出的两根杆将其挂在架子上。
